title: muster release v5.34.5

### Fixed
- **The chart no longer publishes an unauthenticated muster.** `ingress.enabled` or `gatewayAPI.enabled` rendered a route while `muster.oauth.server.enabled` was false (its default), and without OAuth muster serves every request as the synthetic `default-user`. The render now fails and names the switch; `muster.oauth.server.acknowledgeUnauthenticatedExposure: true` allows it for a deliberately unauthenticated install behind a trusted proxy. agent-platform is unaffected: it enables OAuth and leaves both switches off. ([#1071](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1071))
